# Marketing Campaign Launch Checklist

Every external campaign must have an assigned owner, target audience, approved budget, success
metric, and launch date recorded in the Marketing project.

Brand review is required for new visual assets. Legal review is required when a campaign includes
customer claims, comparative statements, sweepstakes, or a new collection of personal data.
Customer logos and quotations may be used only when the CRM record contains written permission.

Tracking links must be tested in staging before launch. Within five business days after the
campaign ends, the owner records spend, leads generated, conversion rate, and lessons learned in
the campaign report.
